title: Eric Davis saw classified crash-retrieval evidence with alien bodies

tellings.quote: but I can tell you, yeah, it's a crash retrieval. There's a craft and there's alien bodies.

plain: A craft that crashed was recovered along with alien bodies, according to the physicist Eric W. Davis, who says he has seen classified evidence of this crash recovery. He tells Michels he cannot say much more, only that 'there's a craft and there's alien bodies.' If true, it would mean the US government holds a downed non-human vehicle and its crew.
